recommended_disposition: Fold into the next compact Noether German current-control/source-audit rebalance. Do not loose-upload these packages above reader PDFs/current TeX while the Noether record remains at the Zenodo file ceiling.
summary: Broad post-R272 Noether source-audit wave covering P17 pp.1-35, P24 pp.229-261, P29 pp.28-35, P30 pp.26-61, P31 pp.82-104, P32 pp.221-228, P33 pp.71-73, P35/P36 Cyrillic/Resume clarification, a P37-P43 survival bridge, P37/P38/P39 source audits, and later R273-merge packages that promote only useful R273 fixes into the newer LocalCodex base. The current useful merge flavor also continues Paper 8 full-page checking through pp.95-102 and promotes five Paper 8 source-shape/operator fixes.
global_caveat: These are targeted source-audit/sourcefix/no-patch/current-control packages. Many witnesses are best available rather than strict native650+ evidence: P17/P31/P37/P38/P39 use 600-class source witnesses, P24/P29/P30 use native/best-available around 400ppi, and P32/P33 use high-pixel IA JP2-derived witnesses without embedded DPI metadata. They are not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, not whole-paper certification, not strict native650/1000dpi source closure, and not critical-edition material.

group_summaries.scope: Contiguous Paper 17 source audit from pp.1-35 under GDZ600 complete staged source.
group_summaries.result: One confirmed p10 correction in the first tranche; pp.11-35 add visual/no-patch audit coverage while carrying earlier fixes forward.
group_summaries.caveat: GDZ600 is best complete staged P17 source but below the preferred 650ppi floor.

group_summaries.scope: Paper 24 current-control source-audit chain from pp.229-261.
group_summaries.result: Targeted source repairs to transformed-polynomial ring notation, isolated-component indices, transformed-polynomial sums, noncongruence signs, Hilfssatz displays/prose, barred transformed-domain notation, barred q notation, and tail examples.
group_summaries.caveat: Native GDZ400 source; enlarged crops are readability aids, not independent high-resolution witnesses.

group_summaries.scope: Paper 30 best-available source audit over pp.26-61, closing the paper under the current local P30 chain.
group_summaries.result: Multiple source-certain repairs, especially source-style parenthesized congruence/divisibility notation and small prose/punctuation fixes. The p56-60 package is superseded by the p56-61 COMPLETE package for paper closure.
group_summaries.caveat: P30 uses the best complete IA alternate witness, about 400ppi; not strict high-DPI certification.

group_summaries.scope: Paper 31 pp.82-104 source audit, Paper 32 pp.221-228 source audit, and Paper 33 pp.71-73 no-fix audit.
group_summaries.result: P31 and P32 apply targeted source fixes; P33 records a no-fix source audit against rotated IA JP2-derived witnesses.

group_summaries.scope: P35/P36 Cyrillic/Resume clarification, P37-P43 no-patch survival bridge, P37 p147-152 sourcefix, P38 p399-404 sourcefix, and P39 p189-194 no-patch audit.
group_summaries.result: Confirms the Cyrillic block is source-real Paper 35 Russian Resume material; protects the Paper 43 body boundary; applies P37 and P38 source repairs; records P39 no-patch audit under ICM600 source.

group_summaries.scope: Integrates only useful Web R273 P40 pp.518-519 fixes into the newer LocalCodex base; later packages also continue Paper 8 full-page audit coverage.
group_summaries.result: Raw R273 is not used as a new base. The merge promotes separate (2a)/(2a*) displays with source-shaped second formula and fraktur R in the R-right-module phrase. The newest P40+P8 package should be treated as the current merge flavor because it checks P8 pp.95-102, restores printed 'wo' on pp.97 and 100, restores the semicolon in g(lambda;xy) on p98, changes a p100 equality to the source congruence modulo Delta, and restores a p100 minus sign in the Omega differential equation.
